name: protenix
description: AF3-style prediction (proteins/DNA/RNA/ligands/ions/complexes) with Protenix on Aurora XPU; one row per prediction, returns mmCIF + pLDDT/pTM/ipTM/PAE confidence JSON.
_doc: Per-skill MCP spec (docs/SKILL_MCP_DESIGN.md §5). A thin 'skills' MCP tool protenix.fold(inputs, defaults) validates each row against row_schema, write_files-stages inputs.jsonl + the runner, and calls loam-hpc run_batch(script_path=runner, inputs_path=jsonl, gpus=1, timeout_each). Install paths come from site.<system>.json, resolved worker-side. The runner forces --trimul_kernel/--triatt_kernel torch, passes --use_msa explicitly every run, and rejects any non-offline model (would try to download).
